text.p: SunAmerica Inc, a component of the S&P MidCap 400 Index, will replace Giddings & Lewis Inc after July 16, when the acquisition of Giddings & Lewis by Thyssen AG closes.
Standard & Poor's said SunAmerica will be replaced in the S&P MidCap 400 by Borg-Warner Automotive Inc, a Chicago company that makes automotive parts and systems.
Additionally, Blount International Inc and MacDermid Inc will replace Payless Cashways Inc and Logicon Inc on the S&P SmallCap 600 Index after July 17.

S&P said it is removing Payless Cashways because the company's stock has consistently traded below $1 a share. Logicon is being acquired by S&P 500 component Northrop Grumman Corp. Logicon shareholders will vote on the acquisition July 17.
SunAmerica in Los Angeles is a financial services company specializing in single-premium insurance products, fixed and variable annuities and other long-term savings products.
Blount International in Montgomery, Alabama, makes sporting and logging equipment, industrial tractors, riding lawnmowers, and chainsaw parts.

MacDermid, headquartered in Waterbury, Connecticut, produces and distributes specialty chemicals and equipment for the metal finishing industry and for the manufacture of printed circuits and other electronic parts.
